{{Quote|Whose side are you on?|Roohd, making a snide remark to Senator Amidala|<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref>}}
'''Dantum Roohd''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he was present during [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|raid]] on the Senate in order to free [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]]. He voiced his opinion against [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her colleagues' efforts to bring about peace.

==Biography==
[[File:DantumRoohdInSenate-POP.png|thumb|left|250px|Roohd voicing his opinion in the Senate]]
Dantum Roohd was present in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] lobby in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] discussing the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]]. He was also present during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]] along with other [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] and was taken hostage by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who wanted to exchange their freedom for the release of [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

After the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] was freed, Bane and his team set the charges in the room the senators were held in and left the building. Once safely away, Bane detonated the charges, but the Senators were saved by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who managed to get them away to a safe distance right before the explosion.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

When Senator Amidala and her like-minded colleagues pressed for their campaign to decrease troop production, Roohd constantly voiced against Amidala.

==Behind the scenes==
Roohd's costume design is similar to another senator's design, [[Giddean Danu/Legends|Giddean Danu]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" />
